about: The levels of the patch pyramid from index `from` on are plates of the place. Inside `deg` (inner, outer, degrees from the spot) they carry their own light: the ground as the close view shows it at the handover, laid back and repainted by assets-src/mercury/place, before the lift and knee of the carry. There the plate holds that picture divided by `gain`. `light` and `hold` are options of the globe and both are null in this state. `light` (thin texels of the level before to a pixel: to, from, power) lets the plates' own light come in later than their ground, smooth in the logarithm of the texels; null, the light comes with the plate's weight. `hold` (inner, outer, degrees from the spot) keeps the first level in at every distance and the globe's own relief shading out inside that disc; null, the first level comes in by its texels to a pixel. Why null: both belong to a first level that holds the place's coarse crater field (assets-src/mercury/place/plates.py first). With it the judged hold frame 615 showed the disc as a patch against the approved image, and the judged dive frame 717 showed a soft pale disc in the crisp map where the build b0b87889 does not. So the first level is the finer picture of the map's own ground again and the place's field comes in with the second level, as in that build.
